guarantees: Capture borrows live staging protection and retains the selected header and exact buffered KV snapshot outside the short root/KV locks; unsettled visibility/transaction owners refuse capture.
Strict streaming visitation validates NVT/page structure, buffer keys, effective count, work budget and cancellation without a world-sized key set or an implicit flush.
Shared physical decoding and canonical A/B selection discover unlinked tasks once; captured locators never fall back to live replacements.
All current entities are integrity/role checked within per-entity and total-read bounds; unknown protected inputs, corruption and oversized ordinary entities cannot imply successful absence.
Typed callback errors retain precedence over coincident cancellation, and each simultaneous visit has separate accounted scratch.

Native fixtures cover public callback publication, held checkpoint references, all hash profiles, malformed inputs, pressure/retry and fallible allocations; ordinary snapshot APIs and known-task observations remain covered.
limitations: This scans current KV incarnations, not every stale physical incarnation, and does not prove multi-terabyte startup performance.
Declared checkpoint edges are not validated GC closure, namespace admission, durable retention, resume ownership or activation permission.
Physical retention is publisher-local staging protection; ordinary single-writer/file-lock integration remains U2 work.
Fixed and legacy helper allocations are bounded but do not all expose fallible allocation APIs; this is not universal host-OOM recovery proof.
Task/control writers, capability advertisement, default-v4 cutover, production deployment and retained FS-Server1 database mutation remain disabled or out of scope.
